messages:
Liam (Support): Escalating Sentinel Health onboarding - SSO auth fails for new admins, ~40% of invites bouncing. Pilot customer, renewal check in 10 days. @Rina can you own? :rotating_light:
Rina (CS): On it. Need repro, scope, and comms plan. Do we have any recent deploys to auth?
Noah (Solutions): Suspicious: recent auth-service deploy touched email validation. Liam paste sample error and tenant id.
Liam (Support): Error snippets:
ERROR 2026-11-05T14:05:12Z invite send failed tenant=sentinel-34 err="email_invalid_format" uid=cb12
Repro: Admin invites from console return sent but emails bounce. Ticket 90123.
Priya (Account): I'll draft customer note. Short comms: ack + temporary admin workaround (enable legacy invite link) + schedule 20m screenshare. Owner=Priya, tech=noah. Renewal_flag=true until invites validated.
Rina (CS): Suggest immediate mitigation: enable legacy invite flow for tenant and re-send invites, while Solutions triages. Priya please include workaround steps so customer can continue onboarding.
deploy-bot: Recent deploys: auth-service v3.2.8 -> 2026-11-05T13:50 UTC. Rollback runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/deploy-rollback
Noah (Solutions): Agree it's likely validation change. I'll open PR to relax new validation for legacy emails and ask eng-runtime for a quick rollback if needed.
Liam (Support): Manual re-sends worked for 6/10 users after using legacy flow. 4 still bouncing (invalid domain). Sending bounce samples to Priya.
Priya (Account): Drafted email (10:12): "Hi Sentinel team - we're investigating your invite bounces. Short-term: we've enabled a legacy invite method and re-sent invites. Can we book a 20m screenshare now to confirm admin access?" Sending now.
Rina (CS): Good. Also propose we offer to run invites on their behalf if they prefer. Capture feedback request re: onboarding email templates.
Noah (Solutions): Eng-runtime approved hotfix rollback to v3.2.7 canary. Deploying canary now. Will update in ~20m.
Liam (Support): Canary live at 14:30 UTC; re-sent test invites succeeded. Monitoring tenant=sentinel-34.
Priya (Account): Screenshare completed 14:40 - customer confirmed all admins in; they asked for clearer admin invite guidance and confirmation emails. Recorded feedback.
Rina (CS): Closing loop: issue mitigated, renewal risk downgraded. Follow-ups: create onboarding note for invite UX (owner=Rina, ETA 4 business days), postmortem (owner=Rina), engineering follow-up to add automated invite success telemetry (owner=Noah). Thanks team. :pray:
